nav.aiOnDescription: New applications are extracted and scored against each post's criteria automatically.

profile.title: Profile details
profile.description: Your account, and the preferences that follow you between organizations.
profile.detailsDescription: Your name, email and password are managed from the account menu at the bottom of the sidebar.
profile.noEmail: No email address on this account

language.title: Language
language.description: Your preferred language. This applies to your account across every organization you belong to.
language.label: Preferred language
language.invalid: Pick one of the available languages.

team.title: Team
team.description: Everyone with access to this organization. Membership is managed by your organization's administrator.
team.descriptionAdmin: Everyone with access to this organization. Invite colleagues, set what they can do, and remove access when they leave.
team.rolesExplained: Admins manage billing, the email connection and members. Recruiters run searches — job posts, candidates and university preferences. Viewers can read everything, including resumes, but change nothing. Seats are unlimited on every plan.
team.pendingCount: {count, plural, one {# pending invitation} other {# pending invitations}}
team.emptyDescription: Once people join this organization they will appear here.
team.inviteDescription: They will get an email with a link to join this organization. Seats are unlimited — you are billed on applications, not people.

roleHint.ADMIN: Full access, including billing, the email connection and managing members.
roleHint.RECRUITER: Can create job posts and work with candidates. Cannot change billing, the email connection or members.
roleHint.VIEWER: Read-only. Can see job posts, candidates, scores and resumes, but change nothing.

team.removeDescription: {member} will lose access to this organization immediately. Job posts they created stay, and they can be invited again later.

issues.title: Issues
issues.description: Candidates whose resume could not be read or scored. Each one is a real application that has not been reviewed, so they are surfaced here rather than left to be found one at a time.
issues.needAttention: {count, plural, one {# candidate needs attention} other {# candidates need attention}}

dashboard.title: Job Posts
dashboard.description: Every open role and the candidates screened against it. Scores are produced from the criteria you define on each post.
dashboard.emptyDescription: Job posts you create will show up in this view.
dashboard.statPostsTotal: {count, plural, one {# post in total} other {# posts in total}}

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: Resumes forwarded to your alias that have not been routed to a role yet. Assign one to a job post to move it into that pipeline.
inbox.emptyDescription: Resumes forwarded to your alias land here before they are routed to a role.

failures.emptyDescription: Candidates that fail extraction or scoring show up here so they do not disappear silently.
failures.queuedDescription: Refresh in a moment to see the result.
failures.extractionExplanation: The resume was never read — unsupported format, an unreadable scan, or the model returned something unusable.
failures.scoringExplanation: The resume was read, but judging it against the job's criteria failed.

close.label: Close
close.confirmDescription: It stops appearing as an open role and no new candidates can be assigned to it. Everyone keeps access to its candidates and scores, and you can reopen it at any time.
close.failed: Could not close this job post

reopen.label: Reopen
reopen.failed: Could not reopen this job post

archive.label: Archive
archive.confirmDescription: Nothing is deleted. It is hidden from the dashboard and can no longer receive candidates, but every application, score and referral is kept — find it under the Archived tab and restore it whenever you like.
archive.failed: Could not archive this job post

restore.label: Restore
restore.failed: Could not restore this job post
